onTrue.text: **No Intrusion.** The Intrusion Die shrinks one step on the progression (d2, d3, d4, d6, d8, d10, d12).

onFalse.text: Already at d2 — cannot shrink further.
**Intrusion!** The Intrusion Die grows one step on the progression (capped at its starting size). Reality fractures — roll on the Intrusion Table.

onTrue.text: **1. Whispers from Behind.** Until the end of your next turn, you can only do ONE of the following on a turn: take an Action, a Bonus Action, or move.
**2. Twisting Space.** 30-ft Emanation around you. Each creature in the area (including you) has its Speed halved until the end of your next turn.

**3. Necrotic Drain.** Nearest other creature within 60 ft: CON save vs your spell DC or take Necrotic = 2 × 1d<<['2','3','4','6','8','10','12'][get_cc_max('Intrusion Step') - 1]>> (Intrusion Die at starting size). You regain HP equal to the damage dealt.
**4. Reality Tear.** Until the end of your next turn, you and each creature that can see the tear must succeed on a WIS save vs your spell DC or have the Frightened condition while the tear exists.

**5. Alien Appendage.** For 1 minute, you may make Unarmed Strikes with the warped limb using your spell attack bonus. On hit: Acid damage = ({proficiencyBonus}) rolls of 1d<<['2','3','4','6','8','10','12'][get_cc_max('Intrusion Step') - 1]>> (Intrusion Die at starting size).
**6. Alien Vision.** You have the Blinded condition until the end of your next turn.
**7. Unnatural Thoughts.** You have the Incapacitated condition until the end of your next turn.

**8. Terrible Clarity.** Take Psychic damage = 2 × 1d<<['2','3','4','6','8','10','12'][get_cc_max('Intrusion Step') - 1]>> (Intrusion Die at starting size). For 1 minute, your spell save DC is increased by 2.

**9. Forbidden Recharge.** Regain one expended spell slot of level 5 or lower (your choice). Take Necrotic damage equal to 2 × the slot's level — this damage cannot be reduced or prevented in any way.
**10. Prone Pulses.** Now and at the end of each of your turns for 1 minute, a 15-ft Emanation from you knocks you and each creature in it Prone.
**11. Hateful Whispers.** For 1 hour, while you can hear the whispers you have Disadvantage on WIS ability checks and saving throws.

**12. Summon.** An Aberration or Fiend with CR ≤ your Wizard level (<<levels.wizard>>) appears in an unoccupied space within 30 ft. GM picks the creature, its attitude (Hostile/Indifferent/Friendly), and its actions.

effects.text: Spell modifiers (declare *before* casting if used): **Overwhelming Mind** — creatures have Disadvantage on the first save against the spell. **Seeking Eye** — you have Advantage on the first attack roll for the spell.
